title: Synthetic Control
interviewAnswer: Synthetic control builds a weighted combination of untreated units that reproduces the treated unit’s pre-treatment trajectory, then uses post-treatment divergence as an estimated effect.
keyPoints: Useful for one/few treated aggregate units.
why: Synthetic Control appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
intuition: Useful for one/few treated aggregate units.
deepDive: Synthetic control builds a weighted combination of untreated units that reproduces the treated unit’s pre-treatment trajectory, then uses post-treatment divergence as an estimated effect. Pre-treatment fit is crucial. Placebo/permutation checks help assess unusualness. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Construct a synthetic region from other regions to evaluate a citywide intervention.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
Choosing it because it is familiar rather than comparing against an appropriate baseline.
followUps: What assumptions does Synthetic Control make?
How would you validate or debug Synthetic Control in practice?
production: In production, validate assumptions on real data, monitor the quantities that can drift, and keep a simple baseline so added complexity has a measurable reason to exist.
